summary: The owner decided (2026-11-12) that the S07-R2 canary succeeds only when its collection reconciles verified. A not-observed result shows the call went through, not that the trial can measure an effect. Both G2 canaries so far were not-observed. The trial plan, SPEC-07 and the specs README now say so, and the runbook gains a section on getting a verified canary: give production time, free storage by hand if full, and re-dispatch step=canary before the canary authorization expires on 2026-11-26. Block 1 does not open until it is verified.

contract_status_changes.contract: Require a verified canary before the SPEC-07 trial opens
contract_status_changes.before: S07-R2 did not define canary success
contract_status_changes.after: S07-R2 requires a verified reconciliation; runbook says how to get one
proof: make syntax-check, make test, scripts/spec_trace.py and git diff --check pass

residual_risks: Docs only; the verified canary itself is an owner dispatch.
